method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the Lindenbaum enumeration, stage construction, consistency induction, nesting induction, finite-subset argument and completeness conclusion, followed by exact formula, macro, controlled-token, tag, label, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Lindenbaum's lemma: extending a consistent sentence set to a complete consistent set by a stagewise enumeration construction.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section announces and states Lindenbaum's lemma: every consistent set of sentences in a language is contained in a complete consistent extension, obtained by deciding each sentence or its negation without introducing inconsistency.
samples.checks: The named result, language L, original set Gamma, extension Gamma-star, consistency and completeness claims are all retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Enumerate every sentence A_n, begin with Gamma_0 equal to Gamma, and at stage n add A_n when that extension is consistent; otherwise add not-A_n. Gamma-star is the union of all stages.
samples.checks: Every index, set equation, cases branch, consistency condition and the n-greater-than-or-equal-to-zero union are exact; Marathi prose inside textrm remains excluded from formula text while its embedded formula is checked.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Each stage is consistent because if both the positive and negative extensions were inconsistent, exhaustive provability would contradict the induction hypothesis. A second induction proves all earlier stages are subsets of later stages using the construction and transitivity.
samples.checks: Both FOL and propositional reference branches, the two possible extensions, base and induction cases, all inequalities and every subset direction are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Any finite subset of Gamma-star lies inside one largest indexed stage and is therefore consistent; compactness gives consistency of the union. Every sentence occurs in the enumeration, so failure to add A_n means not-A_n was added, making Gamma-star complete.
samples.checks: Finite-subset containment, choice of the largest stage, all four-system compactness references, list coverage and the final A_n-or-not-A_n conclusion remain exact.

source_observations: The frozen source typesets the membership sign in one sentence as the isolated inline fragment '$\in \Gamma_n$'; the target retains that formula exactly and translates only its surrounding prose.
The construction is shared by FOL and propositional-logic tagged builds; both olfileid and every tagged reference option are preserved.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, tags, labels, identifiers and reference options match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
पूर्वप्रमेय is directly supported as a general mathematical role by MR-P104, but its use for named logic lemmas remains expert-reviewable under T195.
The proof relies on the previously established exhaustive-provability and compactness propositions; those results are referenced rather than reproved here.
